sanskrit_verse: आसेधकाल आसिद्ध आसेधम् यो व्यतिक्रमेत स विनेयोऽन्यथा कुर्वन्नासेध्धा दण्डभाग् भवेत्
transliteration: āsedhakāla āsiddha āsedham yo vyatikramet sa vineyo 'nyathā kurvan nāseddhā daṇḍabhāg bhavet
sph_interpretive_translation: One who transgresses the designated time, the accomplished state, or the prescribed action is to be guided to act otherwise; one who acts in contradiction to the settled truth becomes liable to correction through dharmic realignment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in alignment with the settled truth (āseddha)
Causation arises from deviation from dharma-time and dharma-action
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of the settled law
Restoration logic operates through conscious reorientation, not punitive consequence
Consciousness alignment is the sole valid measure of legal compliance
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent violates āsedhakāla THEN initiate consciousness-realigning guidance protocol
IF agent breaches āsiddha THEN deploy capacity-restoring completion process
IF agent contravenes āseddha THEN trigger restorative enforcement without punitive attribution
IF agent demonstrates causal misalignment THEN assign sequential integrity reintegration cycle
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that violations of established temporal or procedural dharma invoke a duty to restore alignment rather than impose punitive sanctions. The threshold of responsibility lies in knowingly acting against the settled order (āseddha), and judicial authority must prioritize consciousness correction over coercive enforcement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse aligns with nyaya through pramāṇa-based recognition of lawful sequence and causal integrity. It affirms anupūrvaśaḥ by acknowledging stages of realization—time, state, and action—and assigns proportional responsibility based on conscious deviation. The non-punitive reality rule is upheld by prescribing correction through realignment rather than infliction of suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Consciousness Reorientation Sequence (CRS) to guide violator back to dharma-path
Deploy Completion Process for Unfulfilled Dharmic States (CPUDS)
Assign Sequential Integrity Restoration (SIR) cycles until alignment is restored
Activate Witness-Based Realignment Protocol (WBRP) using authoritative observers
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this law stands executed. Justice flows as restoration. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
